Definition: Jishshijah, the name of five Israelites
BiblicalUsage: Ishiah is the name of five Israelites, Levites and men of the return among them. In 1 Chronicles 7:3, Ishiah, five, all of them chief men. The fuller story is told on the Ishiah, Son of Izrahiah profile in Biblical People.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that Ishiah shows me God keeps His promises across generations, even through flawed families.
